fills.researcher_notes: Pressure was blank and is now filled at 10 MPa — the design pressure is stated, with this segment named, in three independent places and three document classes: the regulator (MEE 环审〔2021〕104号, 设计压力10兆帕), the operator's own groundbreaking release carried by 中国电力新闻网 2021-09-24 (管道设计压力10兆帕), and commissioning-day press (新华网 2025-09-26, 设计压力10兆帕; 光明网/央视 same day). SUPERSESSION TO RECORD: the earlier 环审〔2014〕16号 approved a SPLIT pressure — 12 MPa on 中卫-枣阳 and 10 MPa on 枣阳-吉安 (with 300 vs 250 亿立方米/年) — but the 2021 major-change approval and every as-built report give a uniform 10 MPa / 250亿m3/y for the whole middle section, matching the sheet's Capacity of 25 bcm/y. 10 MPa is therefore the correct as-built value; the 12 MPa figure is a superseded design and should NOT be staged. PressureUnits uses the tracker's dominant spelling 'MPa' (396 rows) rather than 'Mpa' (14). These same three documents were read for every other column of this row (see the Status, Fuel, PipelineType, FuelSource and Start records) and for the sibling WEP3 rows (see cross_row_leads).

fills.researcher_notes: ProposalYear/Month were blank. Staged 2012 / 3 on the earliest DATED public record of this segment as a named project: the EIA 简本 for 西气东输三线中段（中卫-吉安）states the EIA was commissioned 2012-03-05 (收到委托书) and publicly noticed 2012-03-07, with provincial supplementary notices following in Dec 2012 (陕西 12-04, 湖北 12-03, 江西 12-12) and Jan 2013 (湖南 01-10). ALTERNATIVES THE ORCHESTRATOR MAY PREFER, stated explicitly rather than buried: (a) 2011 — 环审〔2014〕16号 cites 国能油气〔2011〕20号, the NEA's consent for WEP3 preliminary work, but that is a SYSTEM-level (whole WEP3) act, not a middle-section proposal, and the aggregate-vs-segment rule argues against it; (b) 2014-06 — the NDRC 核准 (approval), which is a decision on a proposal, not the proposal itself. 2012-03 is the first public appearance of '中卫-吉安' as a project and is what I staged. SOURCE-DIVERSITY FLOOR NOT MET, deliberately: both refs are mee.gov.cn, i.e. ONE publisher, so tier is medium and independent=false. I searched for a non-MEE 2012 record of the segment proposal — the four provincial EPB notices the 简本 names are the obvious candidates but none survives at a fetchable URL (the 简本 gives no URLs, and the provincial EPB sites have been reorganized twice since); gov.cn's 2014-08-25 and 2016-12-12 WEP3 items in the harvest pool are hard 404s; the NDRC 2021 statistics page is a 404. If ProposalMonth is judged too fine for an EIA-notice date, drop the month and keep 2012.
